REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3, u4
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u4
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, blocker_moved & has_door_key) -> u2
(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, door_open) -> u3
(u2, else) -> u2
(u3, target_picked_up) -> u4
(u3, else) -> u3
(u4, else) -> u4
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved, u1) -> 0.1
(u1, blocker_moved & has_door_key, u2) -> 0.1
(u2, door_open, u3) -> 0.2
(u3, target_picked_up, u4) -> 1.0
feedback: Accepted. Format matches the paper template exactly: STATES, INITIAL_STATE, nonempty FINAL_STATES (u4, declared in STATES and accepting via an else self-loop), TRANSITION_FUNCTION lines of the form (state, event) -> state, and REWARD_FUNCTION lines of the form (from, event, to) -> reward mirroring every forward transition. Every state carries an else self-loop, so events off the forward path - key_lost, has_door_key alone in u0/u1, stale door_open reads, no-ops - are absorbed without spurious transitions. The chain covers the ordered subgoals and the stated preference: u1->u2 requires blocker_moved & has_door_key, so the key milestone only counts while the ball is clear of the door; taking the key first earns nothing and the agent must re-take it after moving the ball, which is exactly the 'ball out of the way before the key' preference. The conjunction also respects blocker_moved's persistent semantics (no premature +0.1 if the ball is dropped back and the key grabbed while the door is still blocked; the ball physically prevents toggling, so no door_open is missed in u1). Reachability holds from every state: the key-first deviation recovers via ball pickup -> u1 -> key re-take -> u2 -> toggle -> u3 -> drop key, pick box -> u4; u2 recovers from a key drop through its else loop and re-toggle; u3 needs only drop-key-then-pickup, and key_lost correctly stays false there since the door is open. Rewards are non-negative, dense, and bounded (total 1.4), with no farming: else self-loops instead of explicit regressions prevent drop/re-pickup cycles from re-firing +0.1, door_open cannot repeat (no relocking), and target_picked_up ends the episode; wiring key_lost as an explicit regression would have created such a farming loop, so leaving it unused is the safe choice. Minor note: undiscounted totals are equal for both orders, so the preference acts through milestone gating and reward timing (plus any discount/step pressure) rather than a lower-paying violation branch - acceptable for a 'preferably' clause.

feedback: All five declared propositions are defined, with no missing or extra functions. blocker_moved: scans the grid for the unique door and checks the cell at (dx-1, dy) for a ball — exactly the reference semantics (ball starts at (dx-1, dy) per _gen_grid); a carried ball is off-grid so it counts as moved, and dropping it back makes it false again. The scan reformulation is equivalent since there is exactly one door, and x-1 is always in bounds because the door sits in the interior shared wall. has_door_key, door_open, and target_picked_up match the documented expressions character-for-character (carrying check, door color match, is_open, mission string f-string match). key_lost correctly implements event semantics: it reads the read-only previous_valuation, requires prev has_door_key true, recomputes the current has_door_key and door_open expressions inline as not-K and not-D, and yields a single-step event. The truthiness guard on previous_valuation short-circuits safely at the first step where all values are false, without changing semantics. Code uses only the documented API (env.grid.get with None guards, env.carrying, env.mission, env.width/height, env.episode_memory['previous_valuation']); no imports, actions, mutations of the environment or episode memory, or side effects; syntax is valid Python; all return paths yield boolean-valued results. Alignment, boolean fidelity, API scope, persistent/event semantics, and safety all verified.

If the door has been toggled shut, reopen it first; the RM remains in u3 until target_picked_up.",
  "u4": "Terminal success state: the agent is carrying the mission-designated box, so target_picked_up is true and the episode ends immediately. The task is complete, no further objective remains, and this final RM state self-loops if any further transition were considered."
